blocks.text: Bring structured entrance-exam assessments, customised practice tests and meaningful performance insights into one dedicated workspace for your institute.
Manage batches, run online or printable assessments, and give your academic team a clearer view of where students need attention.
Request a Demo
**Secondary CTA:** Explore Institute Plans
Compact facts:
**4 available examinations:** JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG and NDA
**13 supported question formats**
**40,000+ previous-year questions tagged for JEE**
**1–300 questions per custom test**
See More Than the Final Score.

When assessments run across several batches, preparing papers and recording marks is only part of the work. Academic teams also need to understand which questions caused difficulty, which topics need further attention and how students used their test time.
**Keep multiple batches organised.** Manage students in groups and assign the right assessment to each batch.
**Make paper preparation more focused.** Start with available tests or select questions for the subjects, topics and difficulty levels you want to assess.
**Look beyond overall marks.** Review accuracy, mistakes and time spent to understand the pattern behind a student's result.
**Monitor performance consistently.** Use student reports and institute-level analysis to follow assessment performance.
**Identify topics that need teaching attention.** Examine subject and topic performance before deciding what to revisit with a class or batch.
**Reduce repeated assessment administration.** Bring student organisation, assignments and reports into a dedicated workspace.
From Batch Organisation to Performance Insight.
**Manage Students & Batches**
Add and manage students within your subscription's seat limit. Organise them into batches or groups so assessments can be assigned to the right learners.
**Access Ready-to-Use Tests**

Browse available full papers, part papers, previous-year papers and topic practice. Filter by examination, year, subject and topic; preview questions without revealing answers before assigning a test.
**Create Custom Assessments**

Build tests with 1–300 questions using Rank Sarthi's question bank, your institute's own questions, or both. Preview the paper, swap questions and publish when ready. Monthly custom-test allowances depend on your plan.
**Assign and Schedule Tests**
Assign assessments to individual students or groups. Set start and end windows and control the number of attempts permitted.
**Understand Student Performance**

Review institute-wide and test-level performance, question-wise accuracy, difficulty, time spent, and subject and topic analysis. Individual students receive mistake analysis, strategy recommendations and downloadable PDF reports.
**Conduct Online and Printable Assessments**

Use an NTA-style or standard exam screen for institute-created tests. Download published papers with your institute's logo and contact details, with a separate teacher answer key for classroom assessments.
Additional text link: **Need a specific assessment?** Your institute can request a test from the Rank Sarthi content team. Discuss request availability and scope with your representative.
Built Around Your Academic Context.
For Coaching Institutes

Bring structured JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG and NDA practice into your batch assessment programme. Assign available papers, create tests around taught topics and use performance reports to decide where your batches need further practice.
For Schools

Support students preparing for competitive entrance examinations alongside their school studies. Use supplementary practice, targeted assessments and progress reporting to understand entrance-examination readiness and areas needing attention.
A Clear Assessment Workflow for Your Institute.
**1. Choose an institute plan**
Discuss your student seats, examination focus and required assessment allowances.
**2. Add students and organise batches**
Add learners within your seat allocation and group them into the batches you teach.
**3. Assign or create assessments**
Select a ready-made test or build a custom paper using available questions and your own content. Set assignment windows and attempt limits.
**4. Review results and identify learning gaps**
Review student and institute reports to understand accuracy, topic performance, difficulty and time spent. Use the evidence to inform your next academic decisions.
Familiar Formats. Controlled Test Delivery.

Students can practise with exam-style interfaces and question formats relevant to their preparation. Institute-created tests can use an NTA-style screen or a standard assessment screen, with scoring based on the selected marking scheme.

Rank Sarthi supports 13 question formats, including single- and multiple-correct questions, numerical and integer answers, assertion–reason, statement-based questions, matching formats and passage-based questions. Your paper can use the formats appropriate to its examination and learning objectives.
Assignment windows and attempt controls help you manage when students take a test. Answers are saved automatically as students work.
Understand Where Academic Attention Is Needed.
An overall score shows the result. More detailed analysis helps your team understand what contributed to it.
**For teachers:** Review question-wise accuracy and subject or topic performance to identify concepts that may need further explanation or practice.
**For academic management:** Examine institute-wide and test-level performance, including difficulty-based results and time spent, to review assessment patterns across your programme.
**For students:** Access scores, performance insights, mistake analysis and strategy recommendations, with downloadable PDF reports for further review.

Questions are tagged by examination, subject, topic, subtopic, question format, difficulty and question nature. This structure supports targeted test creation and more specific interpretation of results—for example, distinguishing conceptual questions from application-based or multi-concept questions.
Student reports can include AI-generated performance insights to support interpretation of an attempt. These complement, rather than replace, academic judgement.
Keep Your Identity Visible in Assessment.
Manage your institute's logo, address, website and contact details in its profile. Your logo can appear in your institute portal and your students' portal.
For classroom assessments, download published tests as print-ready question papers carrying your logo and contact details. A separate teacher answer key supports offline administration.
Working in a Dedicated Institute Workspace

Institute data is kept separate from other institutes' data. The platform supports email or mobile OTP sign-in, one active device per account, session checks during tests, automatic answer saving and audit trails for sensitive actions.
Entrance-Examination Practice, Clearly Defined.

BITSAT

The upcoming examinations are not currently offered for purchase or enrolment. Tell us about future interest when discussing your institute's requirements.
Questions from Schools and Coaching Institutes.
**1. Is Rank Sarthi suitable for both schools and coaching institutes?**
Yes. Coaching institutes can use it for examination practice and batch assessments. Schools can use it for supplementary entrance-examination practice and progress monitoring.
**2. How do student seats work?**
Institutes add and manage students within their subscription's seat limit. Your quotation will confirm the proposed number of seats and associated plan details.
**3. Can we organise students into batches?**
Yes. Students can be organised into batches or groups, and tests can be assigned to individuals or groups.
**4. Can our faculty create custom tests?**
Yes. Institute-created tests can contain 1–300 questions. You can preview a paper, swap questions and publish it. The monthly creation allowance depends on the subscription plan.
**5. Can we use Rank Sarthi's question bank?**

Yes. Custom assessments can use the available question bank. The test library also includes full papers, part papers, previous-year papers and topic practice. The product specification identifies 40,000+ previous-year questions tagged for JEE.
**6. Can we add our own questions?**
Yes. Institutes can use their own questions alongside Rank Sarthi's questions when creating customised assessments.
**7. What analytics are available?**

Available analysis includes institute-wide and test-level performance, question-wise accuracy, subject and topic performance, difficulty-based results and time spent on questions. Student reports include mistake analysis, strategy recommendations and downloadable PDFs.
**8. Can we conduct printable classroom assessments?**
Yes. Published tests can be downloaded as print-ready question papers with your institute's logo and contact details, alongside a separate teacher answer key.
**9. Can our institute's branding appear in the portal?**
Yes. You can manage your logo and institute details. Your logo can appear in your institute portal and your students' portal, as well as on printable assessment papers.
**10. How do we arrange a demonstration?**

Use the institute demo enquiry form to share your details, student volume and examination interests. The team can then discuss a demonstration with you. Submitting an enquiry does not itself confirm a meeting time.

Plans for an Institute, Not an Individual Subscription

Institutional subscriptions support the management of students, batches, assignments and assessment reports in a dedicated institute workspace. They are separate from individual student subscriptions on the RankUp platforms.
Tell us about your student volume and examination focus so the proposed seats, feature inclusions and assessment allowances can be discussed together.
What Your Institute Can Access
**Student seats and batch management**
Manage students within an agreed seat allocation and organise them into batches or groups.
**Test library and assignments**
Access available assessment content and assign tests with start and end windows and attempt limits.
**Custom test allowances**
Create assessments with 1–300 questions using Rank Sarthi's bank and your own questions. The permitted number of custom tests per month depends on the plan.
**Student and institute reports**
Review student performance and institution-level assessment insights, including question accuracy, topic performance, difficulty and time analysis.
**Institute branding and printable papers**
Manage institute identity details and download published papers with branding and separate teacher answer keys.
**Administration and billing**
Institutional subscriptions support seat-based access, activation codes, online or offline payments and GST invoices billed to the institute.
Your quotation will confirm specific quantities, inclusions and allowances. This page does not publish institutional prices or fixed package entitlements.
How to Request an Institutional Quotation
**1. Share your institute's requirements.** Tell us what kind of institution you run and how you want to use assessments.
**2. Specify student volume and examinations.** Indicate approximate student numbers and whether your focus is JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET UG or NDA.
**3. Discuss a suitable plan.** Review the proposed seat allocation, relevant features and assessment allowances with the team.
**4. Receive a tailored quotation.** Review the proposed inclusions and commercial details before making a decision.

Institute Plan FAQs
**How do I request a quotation?**
Complete the quotation enquiry form with your institute details, approximate student count and examination focus. These details help the team discuss your requirements.
**Are institutional subscriptions based on student seats?**
Yes. Institutes manage students within their subscription's seat limit. The proposed allocation will be confirmed in the quotation.
**Do custom-test allowances differ by plan?**
Yes. Monthly custom-test creation allowances depend on the subscription plan. Each institute-created test can contain 1–300 questions.
**Can I see a demonstration before discussing a plan?**
You can submit an institute demo enquiry. A demonstration request and a quotation request are separate enquiries; neither confirms a purchase or a meeting time.
**Can our institute use its own questions?**
Yes. Custom assessments can combine your institute's own questions with Rank Sarthi's question bank.
**Are GST invoices supported?**
Yes. Institutional subscriptions support GST invoices billed to the institute.

blocks.text: Explore how approved Rank Sarthi capabilities can support common institutional assessment needs.
**These are illustrative use cases, not verified customer case studies or measured outcomes.**
Request a Demo
Weekly Mock-Test Programmes
**The assessment need**
A coaching institute wants to run a regular practice programme across batches preparing for competitive entrance examinations.
**How Rank Sarthi can support it**

An administrator selects available full papers, part papers or topic practice, assigns each assessment to the relevant batch and sets its start and end window and attempt limit. The process can be repeated for subsequent assessments; this does not imply an automatic recurring-schedule feature.
**What the academic team can review**
After each test, review test-level performance, question accuracy, subject and topic results and time spent. Use student reports to follow individual assessment performance.
Identifying Learning Gaps
**The assessment need**
A teacher wants to understand why a batch struggled with an assessment rather than relying only on total scores.
**How Rank Sarthi can support it**
The team examines question-wise accuracy, difficulty-based results and subject or topic performance. Time-per-question analysis provides another perspective on how students approached the paper.
**What the academic team can do next**
Use the findings to decide which concepts to revisit or practise further. The teacher makes the instructional decision; this is not an automated lesson-plan or intervention service.
Customised Batch Assessments
**The assessment need**
Faculty want a paper that reflects the topics recently taught to a particular batch.
**How Rank Sarthi can support it**

Select questions from the available bank, add institute-created questions and build a test containing 1–300 questions. Preview the paper, swap questions where needed, publish and assign it to the selected batch. Monthly creation allowances depend on the institute's plan.
**What the academic team can review**
Use the results to examine understanding of the assessed subjects and topics, including difficulty, accuracy and time spent.
Branded Classroom Examinations
**The assessment need**
An institute wants to conduct a classroom examination using a paper that carries its identity.
**How Rank Sarthi can support it**
Download a published assessment as a print-ready question paper with the institute's logo and contact details, and obtain the separate teacher answer key for offline administration.
**What remains with the institute**
Arrange classroom delivery, supervision and marking. This use case does not claim automatic scanning, offline-answer import or analytics generated from paper responses.
Institute Use-Case FAQs
**Are these verified customer case studies?**
No. These scenarios illustrate how approved platform capabilities can support common assessment workflows. They do not represent named customers or measured outcomes.
**Can these workflows be used for more than one batch?**
Students can be organised into batches or groups, and tests can be assigned to the relevant groups within the institute’s subscription limits.
**Does printable assessment include automatic processing of paper answers?**
This proposal covers print-ready papers and separate teacher answer keys. It does not claim scanning, automatic offline marking or paper-answer analytics.
**How can we discuss a workflow for our institute?**
Submit an institute demo enquiry with your examination focus and assessment needs.
